course_info.faculty: Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences
course_info.course: Special Topics in CS: Internet of Things Sensing System - CS 48007

catalog_course_description: Introduction to the Internet of Things, Examples of mobile and embedded systems, and sensors, Sensing Pipelines, Signal Processing for sensor data, Machine Learning for sensing, System Considerations, Networking for IoT, Energy preservation, Privacy in Sensing, Embedded Sensing Architectures, On-device sensing on smartphones, Sensing with purpose-built devices on the edge, Wearable devices, Edge/Cloud Computing in Sensing, Remote inference, Offloading computations, Prominent Applications
course_learning_outcomes: Students will gain an understanding of the tools used in the Internet of Things (IoT) sensing applications
Students will have the ability to explain critical trade-offs involving energy and communication on mobile and embedded systems
Students will demonstrate hands-on experience with sensing applications in the edge IoT settings
course_objective: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) Related to This Course: Affordable and Clean Energy Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure Reduced Inequalities
